[u][b]Hydronias International Voice - 19th August 2026[/b][/u]

Over the last few days, Hydronia has been presented with two very large and difficult diplomatic challenges, whilst issues in Tallisland and with the Republik trade deal continue to pile up in front of President Bozkan.

The first would be the issue of Astanir. The conflict in this country had largely been ignored by Hydronia, as bigger international happenings shook the world stage. However, the war has recently began to reach an end, with the nation of Qianxun playing a key role in this. The new Peoples republic that has been proclaimed has asked the international community, including Hydronia, for recognition. In reality, Hydronia only has two real options here: recognise the state, or declare neutrality. The current Hydronian government could never decline the recognition, as this would inadvertently express support for the far rightists of the country, something Hydronia under its current government could never do. 

Hydronia would also have to take into account the work in progress trade deal with Daesun. This deal would declare Hydronia officially neutral in Astanir, meaning that after the deal was signed, Hydronia would be unable to recognise the peoples republic. However, until the deal was signed, Hydronia could still do some good for the people through aid.

Officially, President Bozkan would announce that Hydronia will retain its neutrality in the Astanir conflict, not officially recognising any successor to the late military union, but that Hydronia was going to maintain its humanitarian commitments by sending 6 billion gilders worth of food relief to Thýven for redistribution, along with an additional 3 billion gilders sent directly to the bank of Tharkønn for use in Astanir.

Thýven itself would be the second issue for Hydronia to contend with, and this one would be far more controversial. The new Thrømm government, an orthodox empire, would at first seem like nothing more than another step in the path to political stability after the fracturing of Elseyr-Vespurias, but as the country progressed and the government began making more and more controversial statements, Hydronia would begin to become worried.

Thývens worries around Daesun would be somewhat justified. The state did have an isolationist history, as well as increasingly imperialist tendencies. The genocide of the Argossian Astanirans had also become well-known news across the world. Whether Daesun decided to acknowledge it or not, nobody could deny that the eastern giant was going down a very narrow path if they wished to keep their reputation in the international community. Whilst Hydronia would stick to attempting a trade deal with Daesun, in the interest of allied cooperation, Hydronia would begin giving more resistance to Daesun at negotiations, as well as President Bozkan noting in his speech that Hydronian is still, as always, steadfast in its commitment to THEP.

The situation with Daesun wouldnt be the most concerning thing about Thývens recent orthodox tangent. The most worrying statement that had come out of the country recently would be the Gøsfoddes motion to suspend the Bobian commonwealth from THEP. Hydronia would see this idea as simply preposterous. The Bobians are a valuable ally to Hydronia, Thýven and THEP as a whole, with both strategic positioning, naval supremacy and oil reserves. In his address to the world, President Bozkan would dismiss the Gøsfoddes urges as the product of paranoia around Daesun, assuring them that the Bobians do not have any bad intentions towards their allies, which they need as much as we need them. He would also go on to emphasise the importance of diplomacy to resolve issues within THEP.

Whilst Hydronias response may appear collective and decisive to the international community, the reality of it would be very different. These issues, along with the Tallislandic civil war and the trouble with the Neue Republik would be the cause of great deliberation in the parliamentary assembly, sometimes even threatening to tear apart the current governing coalition. Despite this, the coalition of the left would manage to keep control of the situation as Hydronias politics and economy continue to be on the way up in 2026.

[spoiler=The Issue][quote=qianxun;60611811](All mentioned nations who are not involved in this war should only read the section entitled [b]"The People's Republic of Astanir"[/b], which among other things asks them to recognize that eponymous state as the sole legitimate successor to the Astaniran Republic.)

[b]The People's Republic of Astanir[/b]

Victory was imminent. The Astaniran people could feel it. In these bombed out homes and on the streets that had split open through the sheer intensity of missile and rocket fire and across the polluted rivers and its rat-infested landfills with its starving children collecting recyclable junk to be sold for the barest scrap, the lowest, weak, and dying dregs of the human race were slowly but surely unifying behind the feeling that the end was near.

Horano Benir, Chairman of the Committee of Executives of the Democratic Council (CEDC) was quite well-aware of this, and in the morning of 17 June 2026, he would humbly ask all non-Astaniran members of the CEDC government to resign their posts. David Cyriacus and Yun Caibo, the seniormost of these "foreign" officials, would quickly accede and have all subordinate foreigners also resign, at last leaving CEDC with an all-Astaniran regime. After all, these Qianxun, Sanguinian, and Vespurian advisors had already taken up position in QASIC. 

Their continued meddling in the Astaniran Democratic government itself was no longer warranted or needed.

After a brief meeting with the rump CEDC, Benir receive consensus that time was now right to formally abolish the Democratic Council and all Arono-era institutions and to make provision for the creation of a new Astaniran state. At conference of senior officials in the capital city of Astan, Benir would proclaim the formation of the "Astaniran supreme power", a provisional technocratic government that was to map out the popular vision of the post-civil war Astanir, inviting the entire Democratic movement, the popular committees, and the non-affiliated citizenry to elect representatives in their respective localities to prepare a Constituent Assembly that was to draft a new constitution.

Until matters could be resolved, this new state is to be called the "People's Republic of Astanir", and was to operate along a "socially-conscious political line" to ensure the rapid upliftment of Astanir's beleagured, traumatized, and hapless populace after all these years of brutal civil war, internal strife, corruption, and national degradation.

To this end, the Benir government would ask the international community to recognize the People's Republic of Astanir "sole successor to the rights and obligations" previously beholden to the still technically extent Astaniran Republic. The Tribal Republic of Kuhaw-Astan, an ally of the Benirist government, would by comparison be declared to be a completely new entity, not representative of the Shamatine Astaniran nation but rather of its substantial Argossian minority, which had previously fought as an independent belligerent due to years of abuse by Astanir's dictatorial governments long past.

Even more specifically, Horano Benir would ask the nations of Erene to adopt a policy of non-recognition towards the Daesunian-dominated United Democratic Forces, a paramilitary group currently occupying the Astaniran Southern Islands. (https://i.imgur.com/4i7a2k0.png). On its exact reasoning for this appeal, the Benirsts would list a number of key points:

[list=1][*]In occupying the Southern Islands, UDF forces [url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=rmb/postid=60453738]instigated ethnic cleansing operations[/url] to eradicate the islands' native Argossian minorities, which constituted genocide.

[*]The UDF, being an Amaralo-centric paramilitary force, is openly racist, supremacist, extremist, and imperialist. It has no goals of uplifting the Astaniran nation, rather expediting the prompt separation of the ethno-state they've crafted into the Daesunian sphere of influence.

[*]The government of Daesun, which is the UDF's foremost patron, had illegally declared these islands to be one large "humanitarian zone", which operates in direct contravention to Astaniran sovereignty.

[*]Daesun has encouraged UDF units to maintain substantial military forces within this "humanitarian zone" until such time that their seccession can be made into [i]fait accompli[/i] by the international community.

[*]The People's Republic of Astanir presently controls the national capital and the overwhelming majority of state institutions. Through this, it has provided social breakthroughs, in the conducting of local elections, the resolution to the Llyndorran flu that has tormented the city of Astan, the rebuilding of Astanir's war-torn cities, and the resumption of commercial enterprise during the nation's darkest hour.[/list]

Having resolved that all these stated points were truths, with objectively verifiable evidence of their occurences through Nordiheimian accounts of the rescue of Argossian tribes fleeing UDF persecution, Sanguinian records of Daesun's aggressive diplomatic conduct on QASIC's attempts to halt shipments to the UDF, and Daesun's own public proclamations of the so-called humanitarian safe zone, the Benir govenrment would appeal all the "anti-imperialist powers" of Erene to refuse recognition of the UDF and its military occupation of the Southern Islands.[/quote]

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60612715][b]August 18, 2026: The Communist Question and The Peoples Republic of Astanir[/b]

Communism, a word that opposed and derided the very tenets of the idea of the Orthodox Empire. It was a word to be reviled and spat upon, a task which ideologically the government of Thýven was happily willing to commit. However, this was the 21st century, not the 20th, Thýven was in no position to be a reactionary state, anti-this and anti-that were out of the question for the government. 

Thus when the government of Thýven was presented with the fall of the Republic of Astanir, a weak and poorly organised government on an island off the south-easter coast of the continent of Shamat, and the sudden rise of the Peoples Republic of Astanir, the reaction of Thýven had to be weighed carefully.

There were two matters to be addressed, the Thawne doctrine held by the state of Daesun, a large nation located across the ocean to the East of Astanir on the continent of Xianzhou, which prohibited foreign expansion into the continent of Xianzhou, and the position of that nation towards the government of Astanir.

Ultimately the question boiled down to, Do we recognise a country whose primary political form is against our very ideological values, or do we permit a large continentalist state to continue influencing affairs in the east?  

Thýven chose the first of the issues, moving to recognise the newly declared People's Republic of Astanir by permitting a $20 million aid package to be sent by the Bank of Tharkønn for the reconstruction and restabilisation of Astanir,. Furthermore discussions on securing a trade deal with that state would begin among members of the National Financial Committee.

[quote=maqamistan;60615469]Prime Minister [b]Satanay Pasht [/b] was sitting in her office when she was briefed about the recent developments in Astanir. This is one problem arresting people can't save her from.

Stuck between our obligations to our allies in Daesun, and our commitment to anti-imperialism, the government is in a tough spot. President Velazquez managed to say "it's not my problem" between coughs, burnt another cigar, and left for his fishing trip. The prime minister and her cabinet held a long discussion where many... passionate opinions were heard. And what did they decide? Release a nonsensical statement that means literally nothing but sounds serious, while somehow recognizing both governments as legitimate at this point and playing into the side that ends up winning in the end.

Yes, that sounds great, what could go wrong? Long live Maqamistan.

[b][u]Official Communication, Islamic Republic of Maqamistan[/u][/b]

In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.

The Government of Maqamistan is closely monitoring the recent developments in Astanir with great concern. 

Maqamistan reiterates its support for the integrity of Astanir, expresses optimism that further casualties will be avoided, and recognizes the complexity of the situation. The government of Maqamistan deeply concerned for the well-being of civillians regardless of race, ethnicity, religion or political belief. The brotherly people of Astanir have endured great suffering during times of war and political disunity. The People's Islamic Republic of Maqamistan, based on the principles of the Just Order, believes in the restoration of peace and dignity in the region. Maqamistan stands ready to support and assist peacefully, as conditions allow, legitimate brotherly initiatives that strive for the betterment of peace in Astanir. Maqamistan reinstates that its policies will always be guided by its loyalty to the welfare of the peoples, the values of the republic, and the principles of the True Religion.

Long live Maqamistan.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Maqamistan[/quote]
[quote=dhornaper;60613603][b][u]Response to the CEDC[/u][/b]

The government of Dhornaper does not recognise the People's Republic of Astanir and will not involve itself in the Astanir war by selecting a side to lend its diplomatic support. The preconditions to to any recognition of a new state are an IA vote and the cessation of war.[/quote]
[quote=valddera;60611934][b][Official Statement from the Peoples Republic of Valddera][/b]

The [b]Government of Valddera[/b] has taken note of the recent declaration by the so-called [b][i][u]"Peoples Republic of Astanir."[/u][/i][/b]
Valddera [b]reaffirms[/b] its standing treaties of neutrality and cooperation with [nation]Pantagruel[/nation and the UDF.
In accordance with our existing diplomatic agreements, [b]Valddera[/b] continues to recognize the UDF as the sole legitimate successor to the late Astaniran Republic and rejects the unfounded [b]accusations[/b] made against our Daesunite comrades.
Valddera remains committed to [i]Neutrality, socialist progress[/i], and the preservation of stability.[/quote]
[quote=thrysmora;60612381]The Kingdom of Trismora, under the guidance and benevolence of His Excellency Duarte I of Leovigéldo, King of Trismora, Defender of the nation, has made the ever-so-wise decision to proclaim the following declaration after the recent events in Astanir.

[i]"﻿The Kingdom of Trismora, after much deliberation amongst the peers of the realm and the main household, has come to a consensus that we must take due notice of the dissolution of the former Democratic council as it transitions into the new People's Republic of Astanir under the unquestionably wise leadership of Chairman Horano Benir. It is with the Kingdoms that we have our cautious optimism that the new Astaniran authorities will strive to restore civic order, uphold popular representation for its citizens, and bring about a speedy recovery of a nation long beset by continuous war, corruption, and privation. Trismora herself will remain firm and ardent in upholding the principles of national integrity, legitimate governance, and non-intervention. It cannot disregard the grievances of the Astaniran people nor any enduring threat posed by foreign-backed figures operating beyond lawful authority.

1.The Kingdom of Trismora recognizes the People's Republic of Astanir as the principal and legal authority within the territories it presently administers.
2.The Kingdom of Trismora will affirm its support for a peaceful and nationally determined process of reconstruction in Astanir, free from external domination.
3.The Kingdom of Trismora strongly condemns the behavior of the United Democratic Forces (UDF) as actions contrary to the principles of sovereignty."[/i]

The Kingdom of Trismora is ready to provide any assistance to the Astaniran people, from Humanitarian to technical assistance. Hope for diplomatic efforts that could lead to peace is high for the Astanir plight. And surely a permanent solution will come.
